general_information.Description: This course is derived from the Coursera Specialization "HRIC Human Resource Associate Professional Certificate." Human Resource (HR) professionals are crucial to an organization's success, playing an essential role in recruitment and management of right candidates and talents, policy development, and fostering a positive work environment. Pursuing a career in HR enables individuals to significantly contribute to an organization's overall achievements. This program is meticulously designed to prepare aspiring HR professionals. It encompasses five modules, offering a diverse array of engaging videos, interactive activities, assessments, and peer-reviewed projects aimed at enhancing professional expertise and providing a comprehensive understanding of Human Resource Management (HRM) fundamentals. Upon completion of this program, students will understand how to: - Recruit, select, and onboard new employees effectively. - Develop and implement employee policies and procedures that align with organizational objectives. - Foster a positive work culture and enhance employee engagement. - Understand and navigate legal and ethical considerations in HR. Graduates of this program will receive a certificate from Coursera and gain the requisite knowledge and skills to excel in the HR field. Additionally, they will be prepared to undertake the HRCI Associate Professional in Human Resources (aPHR) certification exam, distinguishing themselves as qualified HR professionals.
general_information.StudentTasks: This Course is based on the Coursera Specialization "HRIC Human Resource Associate Professional Certificate" Students have to: - complete the course on Coursera platform prior to deadline. - attend offline sessions scheduled on FAP for instruction and guidance (optional)
general_information.Note: 1) Ongoing assessment: Students who complete all MOOCs before the course deadline will receive 1 bonus point; otherwise, no bonus point will be awarded. 2) Final Exam (FE) = Theoretical Exam (TE) 3) Final Result (FR) = min (10, TE + Bonus) 4) Completion Criteria: TE>=4 and FR>=5

learning_outcomes.CLO Details: Understand the significance and practices of talent management, including recruitment, selection and onboarding.
Create career development plan for an employee, and training and development plan for the organization
Determine compensation and benefit structure based on best practices and motivational theories
Apply effective employee relation management skills using vision, mission, core values, ethics codes, company handbook, and effective employee communications
Apply effective performance management and performance appraisal skills
Understand importance of compliance and risk management, and the role of HRM in Organizational Restructuring and Business Continuity
